completedTasks.title: Create standard ConfirmDialog component
acceptanceCriteria: Create ConfirmDialog.svelte component with variants: info, warning, danger with appropriate color schemes.
Support type-to-confirm pattern for destructive actions requiring user to type entity name.
Mobile-first layout: full-screen on <640px, centered modal on desktop with max-width constraints.
Provide promise-based API for easy integration with async/await patterns.
Support custom content slots for complex confirmations beyond simple text.
Ensure 44×44px minimum touch targets on mobile for all interactive elements.
notes: Use DaisyUI modal-bottom sm:modal-middle pattern for responsive behavior.
Danger actions: red button positioned in safe thumb zone on mobile (bottom-right).
Stack buttons vertically on mobile with cancel button on top for safety.
Auto-focus on cancel button for keyboard accessibility.
Variants: info (blue), warning (yellow), danger (red) with matching button colors.
Type-to-confirm: show input field for destructive actions (delete, hard delete), validate typed value matches.
Promise-based API example: await confirmDialog.open({ title, message, variant: 'danger' }).
Custom slots: allow passing rich content (lists, images) in confirmation body.
Mobile: full-screen modal with header, scrollable body, fixed footer with actions.
Desktop: centered overlay (max-width: 500px) with backdrop blur.
2025-10-01: ConfirmDialogHost + promise-based API implemented with variants, typed confirm, mobile layout—meets acceptance criteria.
